title: The Code on Wages, 2019
verified_how: LDH IN/IndiaCode doc IN_IndiaCode_201929 gives the short title and the India Code handle 15793. Its s.1 footnote shows only partial commencement on 18 Dec 2020 (S.O. 4604(E)), which is an older snapshot. Full commencement on 21 Nov 2025 comes from a PIB release ('Government Makes the Four Labour Codes effective...', PRID 2192463) seen only in search results because PIB blocked the fetch. The same-day commencement of the IRC and OSH Codes is confirmed in India Code text (S.O. 5320(E) and 5321(E), dated 21 Nov 2025).
notes: Wholly in force since 21 Nov 2025. Subsumes the Minimum Wages Act 1948, Payment of Wages Act 1936, Payment of Bonus Act 1965 and Equal Remuneration Act 1976 (repeal section recalled as s.69, not re-read). Central rules were reported as still pending at commencement, with transitional reliance on existing rules. Wages are also administered by the States as 'appropriate Government'.
